$comment: Allowlist for scripts/check-npm-audit.mjs (CI `dependency-audit` job). Entries accept a KNOWN high/critical advisory that either cannot be fixed without a tracked breaking upgrade, or has NO published fix at any version (verify with `npm view <pkg> version` against the advisory's vulnerable range before claiming this — an entry blaming a pending upgrade that would not actually fix it is worse than no entry). Every entry needs: ghsa (the advisory id, any case — one entry can never cover anything else), reason, trackedBy (GitHub issue), expires (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC — an expired entry with a live advisory FAILS the gate; renew only with re-triage). package/severity are optional documentation fields; the gate warns when severity drifts from the live advisory. Policy: docs/security/security-fixes.md § npm audit sweep + CI gate.

entries.reason: Quadratic-time decode in decode-uri-component when a malformed percent sequence forces the fallback path. Patched only in 0.5.1, which is ESM-only, while the one consumer, query-string@7.1.3, require()s it with ^0.2.2 (0.2.2 is the newest 0.2.x). query-string comes only from expo-router@57 (^7.1.3, also in 57.0.29, the newest SDK 57 release), so this copy runs in the mobile app on the user's own device, parsing in-app and deep-link URLs, not on the API or the web apps. expo-router 58 drops query-string, so the fix is the Expo SDK 58 upgrade. Checked 2026-11-03.

Memory exhaustion in zod <4.6.6 when an unbounded array schema validates a huge array. Two copies are in the tree. The runtime one, packages/validation's (which the API and apps validate with), is on 4.6.7, held there by its ^4.6.7 floor. The other is the hoisted root zod@3.25.76, which NO 3.x RELEASE FIXES (3.25.76 is the newest 3.x); its consumers are @expo/cli@57 (^3.25.76), eslint-plugin-react-hooks and zod-validation-error, all dev or build-time tooling reading local config, never network input. CAUTION: the gate matches by GHSA id, so this entry also hides any later regression of the runtime copy below 4.6.6; check `npm ls zod` before renewing. @expo/cli 58.1.19 (Expo SDK 58, required by expo 58.0.23) drops zod, and the other two consumers accept ^4.0.0, so the SDK 58 upgrade (#2329) clears this: delete the entry then. Checked 2026-11-03.
